behavior: Warehouse history persists for every eligible recipient, independent of the removed in-app cap and display preference.
Distinct warehouse events with identical text remain distinct; retry with the same dispatch key stays idempotent.
Warehouse recipient history is excluded from automatic retention pruning.
Optional push admission defaults to 60 per user per minute across devices; excess waits in the DB without incrementing attempts.
New ordinary deliveries start transport TTL on first admitted send, not while waiting; legacy/canary deadlines remain unchanged.
Database CAS/leases and per-user locks coordinate worker and scheduler; UNKNOWN is not automatically retried.
Separate notification-delivery consumer and DB-backed scheduler cache keep history creation separate from provider calls.
Binding pruning cannot cascade-delete retained deliveries; lease/deadline is rechecked after rate-lock waits.
